result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and deletion certification. However, it applies return and deletion of all Customer data upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment, even where other attachments remain active. That is broader than necessary and could disrupt continuing services, undermining the original clause’s intent that selected attachments may terminate independently.
